'''Seyugi''' were the native inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Seyugi system/Legends|Seyugi]] and [[Recopia]]. A nomadic people, they traveled in the sky of the planet on huge [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] barges and kept to themselves. Several hundred years prior to [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Seyugi named [[Karrh]] gathered warriors with potential in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and began training them in arts of stealth and assassination. These warriors became the first [[Seyugi Dervish]]es and began eliminating various threats to Seyugi people, eventually spreading across the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] both Seyugi Dervishes and Seyugi themselves were believed to be extinct, but in fact several hundreds lay dormant frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] in Recopia. The few descendants of Seyugi would call themselves [[Mallif]] and broadcast their philosophies over the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]. Most of the Mallif were not aware of the fact that their forefathers were still alive, but those who did took care of the hidden base and the dormant Dervishes on Recopia.
